name: Keoghtom's Ointment

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Apply a dose
powers.text: Rub a dose on a creature within reach: it regains 2d8 + 2 Hit Points and is cured of poison and disease.

summary: 1d4 + 1 doses: each heals 2d8 + 2 and cures poison and disease.
text: This glass jar, 3 inches in diameter, contains 1d4 + 1 doses of a thick mixture that smells faintly of aloe. The jar and its contents weigh 1/2 pound. As an action, one dose of the ointment can be swallowed or applied to the skin. The creature that receives it regains 2d8 + 2 Hit Points, ceases to have the Poisoned condition, and is cured of any disease.
